title: Library
allSubtitle: {count} items in your library. Filter, sort and add them to collections.
recentSubtitle: Latest outputs of the tools and the assistant. Unsaved ones are removed when retention ends.
collectionMissing: This collection could not be found; it may have been deleted.

kindSubtitle.video: Every video you uploaded, recorded or generated.
kindSubtitle.audio: Voice-overs, music, jingles and voice clones.
kindSubtitle.motion: Lower thirds, intros and animated graphics.

newCollection.title: New collection
newCollection.description: Name the collection; turn on smart mode if you like.
newCollection.name: Name
newCollection.smartHint: AI analyses the content, adds fitting new items by itself and uses the collection in generation under its rules.
newCollection.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional: what is in this collection and when should it be used?
newCollection.createdSuggested: {count} fitting items found in the library; they await your approval.
newCollection.createdEmpty: Fitting new items will be added as they arrive.

assets.noResultsHint: Try another search or different filters.
assets.deleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}?
assets.deleteDescription: They are removed from the library and every collection. {used} of them were used in projects before; published videos are not affected.

asset.sheetDescription: Preview, AI analysis, usage history and collections of the item.
asset.skippedHint: Not analysed because it is outside the analysis scope of its collections.
asset.pendingHint: Analysis is running; tags and a description appear here when it finishes.
asset.peopleNoConsent: People were detected and there is no usage consent. AI will not use it in collections that require consent.
asset.consentToast: Consent saved; the item can be used now.
asset.usageSummary: AI used this item {count} times · last {time}
asset.neverUsed: AI has not used this item yet.
asset.hideFromAiHint: Stays in the library but AI never picks it from any collection.
asset.expiryHint: AI stops using it after this date; it is not deleted.
asset.useInSparkMock: Would be added to the Spark editor (mock)
asset.deleteUsed: This item was used {count} times. It is removed from the library and collections; published videos are not affected.
asset.deleteUnused: The item is removed from the library and every collection.

collection.itemsAndUpdated: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · updated {time}
collection.noDescription: No description. AI decides when to use this collection from its description; add a short one.
collection.pausedBanner: Paused: AI does not pick from this collection right now. Items keep being added.
collection.frozenBanner: Frozen: no new items are accepted; AI keeps using the existing ones.
collection.archivedBanner: Archived: not used by AI and accepts no new items.
collection.expiringBanner: This collection ends in {days} days; AI stops using it afterwards.
collection.expiredBanner: This collection has expired; AI no longer uses it.
collection.pendingBanner: {count} items are waiting for your approval to join this collection.
collection.emptySmartHint: New items that match its rules arrive here after analysis. Add items from the library or upload new files.
collection.emptyManualHint: Pick items from the library or upload new files.

usage.empty: AI has not used anything from this collection yet.

context.promptHint: When AI looks for content it sees this summary and the analysis of each item.
context.noTags: No tags yet; they appear once analysis finishes.
context.previewHint: Try which item AI would pick for a request, and which it would skip and why.
context.previewPlaceholder: e.g. pizza in warm light, dessert close-up…
context.previewEmpty: Type a request or click a tag.
context.previewNoMatch: Nothing matches this request. AI would skip this collection.

settingsTab.generalHint: Name, description and look. The description is context for AI.
settingsTab.intakeHint: What gets into this collection, and how.
settingsTab.policyHint: How often and in which order AI may use the items.
settingsTab.guardrailsHint: Rules that filter out items AI should not use.
settingsTab.name: Name
settingsTab.descriptionHint: e.g. “Dishes on the restaurant menu; used in menu promos and reels.”
settingsTab.pauseHint: AI does not pick from this collection; items and rules are kept.
settingsTab.freezeHint: No new items are accepted; AI keeps using the existing ones. For collections whose season is over.
settingsTab.archiveHint: Leaves the sidebar and AI stops using it; restore it any time.
settingsTab.deleteHint: The collection is deleted; its items stay in the library (you can also delete the ones only in this collection).
settingsTab.smartHint: When on, content is analysed, fitting new items are added and AI uses this collection in generation under the rules below. Turning it off keeps your settings.

smartPoints.point1: Fitting new items are added, or sent for your approval

editDialog.title: Edit collection
editDialog.description: Name, description and look. The description tells AI when to use this collection.

addDialog.title: Add items to “{name}”
addDialog.description: Pick from the library. An item can be in several collections.
addDialog.kindWarning: {count} selected items are of a type this collection does not accept; they can still be added.
addDialog.add: Add {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteDialog.description: The collection and its rules are deleted. Its {count} items stay in the library and in their other collections.
deleteDialog.deleteItems: Also delete the {count} items that are only in this collection
deleteDialog.deleteItemsHint: Items that are also in other collections are kept.

collection.smartOffToast: Smart mode off; the collection is now a plain folder. Its settings are kept.
collection.aiNoteTitle: What does AI use this collection for?
collection.aiNoteEmpty: Add a short note telling AI when to use this collection.

intake.modeDescription: A smart collection can analyse new uploads and generations and fill itself.
intake.modeManualHint: No automatic adding; analysis and AI rules still apply.
intake.modeSuggestHint: Finds fitting items from the description and analysis.
intake.modeRulesHint: Only items matching your conditions get in.
intake.kindsDescription: Items of other types are not added automatically.
intake.kindsEmpty: No type selected; nothing is added automatically.
intake.kindsExisting: The collection already has items of type {kinds}; they stay, but no new ones are added.
intake.rulesDescription: Tags come from automatic analysis; tags you add by hand count too.
intake.matchPrefix: Add an item when it matches
intake.rulesEmpty: No conditions: every item of an accepted type is added.
intake.approvalDescription: Wrong matches can make AI use the wrong content; approval mode is recommended for the first weeks.
intake.approvalAutoHint: Joins as soon as analysis finishes.
intake.approvalReviewHint: Approve one by one or in bulk on the Review screen.
intake.generatedDescription: Outputs you generate and save in the tools and the assistant are added by the same rules.
intake.matchPreview: {count} items in the library match these settings right now
intake.matchOutside: {count} of them are not in the collection

analysis.scopeDescription: Analysis extracts tags, a description, transcripts and more. AI picks based on them.
analysis.scopeImagesHint: Video and audio are skipped; lowest cost.
analysis.scopeSelectedHint: You choose which types are analysed.
analysis.scopeOffHint: AI only knows names and the tags you add.
analysis.offWithAi: With analysis off, AI can only pick by file name and your own tags; wrong picks become more likely.
analysis.offWithRequire: “Only use analysed items” is on, so with analysis off AI cannot use anything from this collection.
analysis.depthQuickHint: Tags and a short description. Seconds, low cost.
analysis.depthDetailedHint: Scene-by-scene inspection, objects and context. More accurate picks, about twice the cost.
analysis.featuresDescription: Each option adds a step to the analysis; turn on only what you need.

featureHint.tags: What is visible: food, table, coffee, daylight…
featureHint.description: Describes the item in a sentence or two.
featureHint.transcript: Turns speech in video and audio into text.
featureHint.ocr: Reads text such as menu boards and price tags.
featureHint.colors: Extracts the dominant colours; used for brand fit.
featureHint.quality: 0–100 score from sharpness, light and resolution.
featureHint.people: Marks whether people appear; needed for consent rules.
featureHint.brand_fit: Measures how well it fits the brand kit (colour, tone).

analysis.peopleNotice: People detection does not recognise faces or identify anyone; it only marks whether a person appears.
analysis.reanalyzeDescription: When an item is trimmed or changed, its analysis is updated.
analysis.budgetDescription: The most credits this collection may spend on analysis.
analysis.estimate: Estimated cost for the current {count} items: ~{credits} credits
analysis.estimateHint: New items are charged as they arrive.

policy.accessDescription: When off, items stay in the library but are never picked in AI generations.
policy.agentsDescription: Which creation surfaces may pick from this collection.
policy.agentsEmpty: No surface selected; AI cannot use this collection.
policy.maxUsesDescription: How many times the same item may be used in total. Keeps the same dish out of every video.
policy.maxUsesImpact: With this limit {count} items immediately reach “limit reached”.
policy.cooldownDescription: How long must pass after an item is used before it can be picked again.
policy.onceDescription: Within one video or automation run, the same item is never used twice.
policy.weeklyDescription: The most items from this collection that may be used in a week.
policy.weeklyTooHigh: The weekly cap ({cap}) is higher than the items available now ({available}); the same items are picked again once they cool down.
policy.rotationDescription: When several items fit a request, which goes first?

rotationHint.random: A different look in every video.

policy.exhaustedDescription: What happens to an item that used up its uses?

exhaustedHint.pause_item: AI skips it until you reset the counter.
exhaustedHint.warn: Used only if nothing else fits, with a warning.
exhaustedHint.archive_item: Leaves the collection, stays in the library.

policy.requireAnalysisDescription: Items still in analysis or whose analysis failed are not picked by AI.
policy.impact: With these settings {available} items are available now · {cooldown} cooling down · {exhausted} at limit · {blocked} blocked.

guardrails.resolutionDescription: Images and videos below it are not picked by AI.
guardrails.durationDescription: Shortest and longest accepted duration for video and audio.
guardrails.lowQualityDescription: Items with a quality score below 70 are not picked.
guardrails.lowQualityCount: {count} low-quality items are in this collection.
guardrails.duplicatesDescription: What happens when identical or near-identical items are added?
guardrails.consentDescription: Items showing people are not used until consent is marked.
guardrails.consentCount: {count} items have no consent; AI does not use them.
guardrails.licenseDescription: Music and stock content without a licence record are not picked.
guardrails.expiryDescription: When the campaign or season ends AI stops using this collection; items are not deleted.

generations.retentionTitle: Unsaved generations are kept for {days} days
generations.retentionHint: {count} generations are not saved. Saved ones stay in the library and can join smart collections.
generations.autoSaveHint: Every finished output goes straight into the library.
generations.autoRouteHint: Saved outputs are suggested to, or added to, the smart collections whose rules they match.

review.consentIntro: People were detected in these items. Until consent is marked, AI does not use them in collections that require consent.
review.failedIntro: Analysis could not finish for these items; AI cannot pick them.
review.duplicatesIntro: Items that look identical or very similar. Merging keeps the usage history.
review.title: Waiting for your approval
review.description: AI won’t use these files or add them to collections without your approval.
review.pendingTitle: {count, plural, one {# item needs} other {# items need}} your decision

upload.title: Upload to the library
upload.description: Uploaded files are analysed, then added to the smart collections whose rules they match, or sent for your approval.
upload.formats: Video, image, audio and text · up to 2 GB per file
upload.autoOff: Smart filing is off; items are only added to the library.
upload.targetSmart: Smart collection: files are analysed after they are added.
upload.targetManual: Files are added straight to this collection.
upload.start: Upload {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
upload.routedNone: No smart collection matched; the items are in the library.

recentRetention: Unsaved outputs are removed after {days} days.
